title: 閉館前十分鐘
subject: swimming the last laps at a public pool ten minutes before closing on the last day of summer holidays
caption: Mandarin slacker indie rock in the Taipei bedroom-band style, loose and unhurried. Two clean electric guitars strummed lazily and a little behind the beat; a warbling lead guitar with tape flutter playing short melodies between lines; loose live drums with brushes and a dry snare; a melodic fingered bass; an alto saxophone answering the chorus. Loose, sun-bleached, dry live-room sound with a slight tape wobble. Female soprano, breathy and close, half-whispered, unbothered. 84 BPM, F major. Drowsy, weightless, quietly reluctant. No shoegaze distortion wall, no long reverb wash, no EDM drop, no R&B runs, no trap hi-hats, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - lazy strummed guitars and brushed drums]

[Verse 1]
八月最後一天 游泳池快關了
救生員坐在高椅上 打了一個哈欠
燈一盞一盞暗下來
我還想再來回 一趟就好

[Pre-Chorus]
哨子還沒響
我把耳朵沉進水裡

[Chorus]
閉館前十分鐘
整座城市都浮在水面上
我在底下 數自己的呼吸
慢慢的 誰也找不到我

[Verse 2]
置物櫃的鑰匙 繞在手腕上
氯的味道 留在頭髮裡一整晚
明天開學 公車要早一站下
今天我還可以 浮著不動

[Pre-Chorus]
哨子響了
我假裝沒有聽見

[Chorus - saxophone joins]
閉館前一分鐘
整個夏天都浮在水面上
我在底下 再數三下
上來的時候 燈已經關了

[Outro - warbling lead guitar and saxophone]
救生員說 明年見
我說 嗯 明年見
